fields.finding: No full-hull or seam/node leak rate is measured. The 1e-5/1e-3/0.1 mbar L/s per metre and per node values are scenarios, with a separate port allowance. They span four decades but are not bounds.
fields.proposed_next: Measure assembled pressure rise and test gas-specific leaks at service load and temperature; compare with the 24 h acceptance budget.
